slides.title: ADHD home confessions (you're not the only one)
Confessions
items: I bought a 2nd vacuum. Found the 1st one.
Clean clothes live in the dryer. Forever.
I hide mess in the oven when guests come
I tidy for 3 hours, then it's back in 2 days
I own 7 water bottles, can find 1

slides.title: Here's the thing
slides.body: Every one of these makes sense for a brain that runs on out of sight, out of mind. None of them mean something's wrong with you.

slides.title: Clothes live in the dryer?
slides.body: Then it's a dresser now. Put a basket next to it. Work with the habit, not against it.

slides.title: It's back in 2 days?
slides.body: That means things don't have homes yet. A tidy room without homes always un-tidies.

slides.title: Confession: my system is chaos. But it's a system now.
Turn chaos into a system
slides.body: The Messy Brain Home Reset is a shame-free 7-day reset for houses exactly like ours. Link in bio.
